description: Render a watermarked preview PDF from an INLINE template definition — free, nothing stored, no payment. Use this to iterate field positions (x, y, width, font_size) until the layout is right, then show the final PDF to the human for approval before issuing. page_width/page_height MUST match the background image's pixel dimensions. The PDF is written to a local file; if you can read PDFs, inspect it and adjust yourself.

background_url.description: Public URL of the background image (PNG/JPG). There is no upload endpoint — the image must already be hosted (own site/CDN, GitHub raw URL, S3/R2, Cloudinary...). Tell the human this upfront. Share links (Google Drive/Dropbox) don't work; the URL must return the raw image.

output_path.description: Where to save the PDF (default: temp file)

page_height.description: Page height in px — must match the background image

page_width.description: Page width in px — must match the background image

name: preview_template
